text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired for service `hosted-inference-dedicated` (P1) — latency and 503 spike in region eu-central-1. PD incident: INC-2026. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026

incidentbot: Primary <@eng_oncall_ali> did not acknowledge within 4m, escalating to secondary <@sre_maya> and manager <@manager_nina>. Duplicate pages suppressed (2 suppressed).

manager_nina: I'm awake, queuing a quick bridge. @sre_maya can you ack and start a triage?

sre_maya: ack. looking. Initial signal: sudden surge of long tail latency with backend pool hitting connection limits and a handful of GPU pods flapping.

sre_maya:
```
# checking pods in eu-central-1 cluster
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=hosted-inference -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase,NODE:.spec.nodeName
# some pods CrashLoopBackOff, others Running but with high restarts
```

sre_maya: grabbing logs from envoy gateway and model pods. envoy shows 503 upstream_errors and a burst of connection resets. model logs show memory pressure and kernel driver warnings (different from standard CUDA OOM).

sre_maya:
```
# sample from model pod log
[2026-03-15T02:15:10Z] WARN kernel: GPU HANG detected on device 0, resetting
[2026-03-15T02:15:11Z] ERROR inference: inference aborted: driver reset during kernel execution
```

sre_maya: hypothesis: NV driver instability after recent kernel module update on some host kernels + aggressive autoscaler that immediately rescheduled onto same host group. Options: 1) cordon problematic nodes 2) shift traffic away from GPU-heavy route to cpu-fallback-model (best-effort) 3) increase connection pool and retry budget at envoy to smooth spikes. Starting step 2 now (traffic shift).

ops_jordan: drafting customer note: "We are investigating elevated 5xx and latency for hosted inference in eu-central-1. Mitigation underway: shifting traffic to fallback instances and isolating noisy hosts. Expect updates every 10 minutes." Approve?

manager_nina: Approve. Add note about no data loss and short-lived degradation. Pin to channel.

eng_oncall_ali: acking now — sorry missed initial page (airplane mode). Oncall phone rules will be updated. Joining bridge.

sre_maya: implemented weighted routing: 40% -> cpu-fallback-model, 60% -> original.

sre_maya:
```
# internal routing API call
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/hosted-inference \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"rules":[{"target":"cpu-fallback-model","weight":40}]}'
```

incidentbot: Routing change applied. PD notes: primary acknowledged at +6m (late). Manager was paged per policy; no manager ack required for closure.

sre_maya: After shift, error rate dropped from ~7.8% -> 0.9% over 4 minutes. However, two hosts still showing driver resets. Cordoning nodes now to avoid rescheduling onto them.

sre_maya:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-host-22-euc1
kubectl drain gpu-host-22-euc1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

ops_jordan: posted status update: https://status.redwood/incidents/INC-2026 - customers notified.

manager_nina: Good. Action items being captured: SRE to open kernel-driver bug ticket with cloud provider; Platform to relax autoscaler immediate reschedule sync for GPU pools; DevEx to add CPU-fallback route for critical services; PD owner to reduce duplicate pages suppression window and review escalation timing.

incidentbot: Note: PD suppressed 2 duplicate pages due to rate limiting; escalation occurred after primary timeout (4m). Suggest checking PD policy thresholds if suppression led to silent missed followups.

eng_oncall_ali: I pushed a quick mitigation to pin the model image version on affected hosts to last-known-good (v2.1-stable) so we avoid the newer kernel-compiled build that interacts poorly with driver.

eng_oncall_ali:
```
kubectl set image deployment/hosted-inference-model v2=registry.redwood/model:v2.1-stable -n inference
```

sre_maya: confirming stability: latency normalizing, error rate ~0.2%. For RCA we'll need: kernel module timestamps, node repro steps, and autoscaler decision logs.

ops_jordan: customer update sent and pinned. Received first support reply from an enterprise customer asking for timeline & mitigation details. I shared current post.

manager_nina: thanks everyone. We'll keep the PD incident open until RCA is published. Quick follow-ups: (1) SRE to file ticket to cloud provider + internal RCA doc, (2) Platform to add a fallback rule that auto-shifts to cpu-fallback-model when "GPU driver reset" pattern detected, (3) PD owner to adjust primary ack timeout to 6m and reduce manager immediate paging unless secondary misses x2 rounds.

eng_oncall_ali: noted. I'll update my oncall phone profile (no more airplane mode during shifts).

incidentbot: Incident channel remains open. Please add logs/timelines to https://confluence.redwood/incidents/INC-2026 when available. :spiral_calendar_pad:

sre_maya: recording timeline and attaching logs to incident doc. closing mitigation phase — monitoring for 30m before moving to postmortem prep. :white_check_mark:
